newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan crown prince's son survives car crash.
newsitem.headline: Jordan crown prince's son survives car crash.

text.p: Prince Rashed, the only son of Jordan's Crown Prince Hassan, is in stable condition after surviving a car crash on Friday which killed two of his companions, the royal court said.

Prince Rashed, 23, was rushed to a local hospital in Jordan's Red Sea port of Aqaba along with his friend Zaid Budair after his car was in a collision on a highway along the Rift Valley, the palace said in a statement.
Two of his companians, Mark Smith, an American, and Major Salamah Kassab were killed in the accident.
"Doctors have ascertained that the state of Prince Rashed and Mr Zaid is good and stable," the statement said, adding that King Hussein had personally supervised the rescue operation.
Crown Prince Hassan, heir to the Hashemite throne after King Hussein, is married to Princess Sarvath, who comes from a prominent Pakistani family, and they have four daughters and a son.
